address: 421/1 Vachira Prakarn Road, Makham Yong, Mueang Chon Buri, Chon Buri, 20000, Thailand
bio: For a taste of long-established local fare, this eight-decade-old gem that holds itself to exacting standards of cleanliness is a must. Tender braised duck meat with savoury gravy is the signature, best enjoyed with rice; fans of spicy food will relish the house-made dipping condiments....
